This fixture preserves the `dream.latest-receipt.v2` Python consumer's exact
rendered document shape and `sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'),
ensure_ascii=False` JSON encoding. It was generated independently of the Rust
renderer. The identifiers are a compatibility example, not an assertion that
this exact run was newly published.

Source-backed contract: hosted Brunn
`entry:01a07eb7-2056-7401-ae42-162c289b3ba1` (September 7, 2026 code comparison).
The original hardened renderer/parser and row validators were verified from
Codex session chunks `3d29dba3240ff6a9a3864d380cd3f54c` (August 28 12:41 UTC,
archived transcript lines 1849 and 1855) and
`b398f1f1b81ac9ee46cafb327c61eafd` (timestamp/canonical JSON implementation).

The original recommendation IDs require `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{2,119}`. A review
ID such as `2026-09-07/1` remains unchanged in durable run/state/decisions; its
briefing transport ID is `dream-2026-09-07-1`, and the original appears in the
summary. UTC timestamps use `Z`, at whole-second precision. No historical
probe-monitoring evidence is fabricated: `mode_flip=false` and
`probe_monitoring=null` are mandatory in this implementation.
